checks.name: Kim Verlot
checks.quote: “Supporting my biorhythm is important to me. Brushing my teeth with Karmicare fits into my daily ritual to help my nervous system transition between day and night. I also find that it helps me enormously to keep my receding gums under control.”
checks.title: Breathing Coach, Heart Coherence Specialist
